questions.text: The college foundation day was cancelled as ........ political workers tried to forcibly enter the campus. (Choose the correct option)

questions.text: Ranjan was accused ........ theft. (Choose the correct option)

questions.explanationHindi:
Answer: (A) of

questions.text: The bride and the bridegroom ........ wearing similar colour outfits. (Choose the correct option)
questions.textHindi: The bride and the bridegroom ........ wearing similar colour outfits. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanationHindi:
Answer: (C) were

questions.text: Radha is very ........ (Choose the correct option)
questions.textHindi: Radha is very ........ (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanationHindi:
Answer: (D) talkative
'Talkative' is the correct adjective form describing a person who talks a lot.

questions.text: Choose the odd one out:
questions.textHindi: Choose the odd one out:
questions.explanationHindi:
Answer: (C) Shoes
Jacket, shirt, and coat are upper-body garments, whereas shoes are footwear.

questions.explanationHindi:
Answer: (B) doesn't he

questions.text: Choose the correct meaning of "At the eleventh hour" :
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct meaning of "At the eleventh hour" :
questions.explanationHindi:
Answer: (D) at the last moment
'At the eleventh hour' is an idiom meaning at the very last moment.

questions.textHindi: Sunita declared that she was ........ last night. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanationHindi:
Answer: (B) robbed
The passive past participle 'robbed' is required after the auxiliary 'was'.

questions.textHindi: He ........ robbed as he was walking out of the bank. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanationHindi:
Answer: (C) got
'Got' can be used as an auxiliary to form a passive structure indicating an event happening to the subject.

questions.text: The fireman ........ the fire. (Choose the correct option)
questions.textHindi: The fireman ........ the fire. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanationHindi:
Answer: (B) put out
'Put out' is the phrasal verb meaning to extinguish a fire.

questions.text: Choose the correct spelling:
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct spelling:

'Popularity' is the correctly spelled word.

questions.text: Sohan's mango is the ........ of all. (Choose the correct option)

questions.explanationHindi:

No article is used before nouns like school, church, bed when referred to for their primary primary purpose.

questions.text: Kamesh is afraid ........ crocodiles. (Choose the correct option)
questions.textHindi: Kamesh is afraid ........ crocodiles. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanationHindi:
Answer: (D) of
The adjective 'afraid' is followed by the preposition 'of'.

questions.text: Criminals ........ no sympathy for innocent people. (Choose the correct option)
questions.textHindi: Criminals ........ no sympathy for innocent people. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanationHindi:
Answer: (C) have
Plural subject 'Criminals' takes the plural verb 'have' to denote possession in the present tense.

questions.text: The letter was written by her. (Choose the correct active voice)
questions.textHindi: The letter was written by her. (Choose the correct active voice)
questions.explanationHindi:
Answer: (A) She wrote the letter.

questions.text: Gajendra's father asked ........ to repay the loan in time. (Choose the correct option)
questions.textHindi: Gajendra's father asked ........ to repay the loan in time. (Choose the correct option)
questions.explanationHindi:
Answer: (B) him
The objective pronoun 'him' is required after the verb 'asked'.

questions.text: I have to buy an ........ of Lord Ganesh
questions.textHindi: I have to buy an ........ of Lord Ganesh
questions.explanationHindi:

questions.textHindi: Choose the correct sentence:
questions.explanationHindi:

Answer: (D) tale
